title: XIRR in one line
body: XIRR turns payments on different dates into one yearly rate, so a 6-month loan and a 3-year bond can be compared fairly.

title: What MOIC tells you
body: MOIC shows how many times your money came back. 1.5x means every ₹100 put in became ₹150. It ignores time, so read it together with XIRR.

title: FD interest is taxable
body: Interest on a fixed deposit is added to your income and taxed at your slab rate. A bank may cut tax before paying you, but you still report all of it.

title: Spread P2P lending
body: A P2P borrower can default, and getting money back can take long. Lending a little to many borrowers hurts less than lending a lot to one.

title: Check the chit is registered
body: Before joining a chit fund, ask for its registration with the state's chit fund registrar. An unregistered chit leaves you with few options if it goes wrong.

title: Gold jewellery costs extra
body: Making charges and GST on jewellery rarely come back when you sell. Coins and bars lose less, so compare before you buy.

title: Close what is finished
body: When an investment has paid everything back, mark it closed. Open ones with no current value show Awaiting instead of a made-up return.

title: Look past the headline rate
body: A 7% return with 6% price rise grows your buying power by only about 1%. Compare returns after inflation, not before.

title: April to March
body: India's tax year runs 1 April to 31 March. A payout on 31 March and one on 1 April fall in different years, and InvTrack's reports follow the same split.

title: Keep cash you can reach
body: Hold 3 to 6 months of expenses somewhere you can withdraw quickly before locking money into a bond, chit or property.
